data: For fiscal 2025, which ended January 26, 2025, NVIDIA reported revenue of about $130.5 billion, up 114% from $60.9 billion in fiscal 2024. Net income was about $72.9 billion, up roughly 145% from $29.8 billion the year before. GAAP gross margin was 75.0%, up from 72.7% in fiscal 2024, and non-GAAP gross margin was 75.5%. The Data Center segment drove most of the growth, with revenue of about $115.2 billion, a 142% increase as demand for its Hopper and early Blackwell AI accelerators surged.
